questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine sacred and profane using anthropological evidence

stimulus.body: A community separates a sacred grove where only certain rituals may occur from the ordinary fields used for daily farming.

options.misconception: It assigns the terms to medicine, which is unrelated.

options.text: The sacred and profane distinction categorizes things set apart for ritual significance versus the ordinary, everyday domain.

questions.explanation: The boundary between sacred and profane is culturally constructed and ritually maintained.
questions.hint: Because some places are set apart while others are ordinary, the distinction applies.
